zoom_zoom_raw.dataset_description: Zoom is a cloud-based video communications platform for virtual meetings, chat and screen sharing.

time.field_description: The time the Zoom user activity or admin operation took place, in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

operator.field_description: The email address of the Zoom account user who performed the admin operation.

category_type.field_description: The category of the Zoom admin operation.

operation_detail.field_description: The description of the Zoom admin operation.

action.field_description: The action the operator performed on the Zoom account object in the admin operation.

email.field_description: The email address of the Zoom user who initiated the sign-in or sign-out activity.

type.field_description: The type of account access activity the Zoom user performed.

ip_address.field_description: The source IPv4 address the Zoom user signed in or out from.

client_type.field_description: The type of Zoom client or platform the user signed in or out from.

version.field_description: The version of the Zoom client the user signed in or out from.

event_type.field_description: The event type of the Zoom record.
